states: Inspected 12 matched before and after pairs on light desktop and a dark touch phone in Chromium 141.0.7390.37 with Playwright 1.56.1. Both exact builds received the same synthetic replies.

On Add and Manage, a refused Test or Save preserves the draft and reports that nothing was saved, alongside the existing actions and collection scope. The saved transport remains visible at Manage actions.
A distinct settings permission denial still withdraws the configuration. A delayed refusal for a previous address does not replace the current draft or its focused input.
interactions: Activated Test and Save in the actual editor with keyboard and touch. The two exact trees issued identical first request bytes, with TLS verification, collection scope and saved-key handling unchanged, and no automatic replay.
Changed the address while Test was pending. The delayed refusal left no stale result. An explicit Test of the corrected fixture reported only the system information read; it did not save.
